caption: A direct-conversion transmitter: the shared local oscillator drives the I/Q modulator; a reconstruction filter cleans the DAC output and a harmonic filter after the PA suppresses 2f_LO and 3f_LO. The PA, duplexer and antenna set output power and EIRP. Duplexer loss lies in both the transmit and receive paths.

spec.title: Direct-conversion transmitter
spec.aria: A direct-conversion transmitter chain from baseband through DAC, reconstruction filter, I/Q modulator, PA, harmonic filter, duplexer and antenna, with a shared local oscillator feeding the modulator.
